claims.event: Taizong held court in the Grand Politics Hall of Shenyang, which became the capital in the third month of Tianming 10; his court there falls in or after that year. Year converted from the Qing reign period with a standard reign-year table (external conversion; inferred). The packet supplies no Qing reign table, so no reignId is used.

claims.statement: Taizong heard government affairs (聽政) in the Grand Politics Hall at the center of Shengjing.

claims.event: Taizu fixed his capital at Shenyang and ordered banner soldiers to build a raised road 120 li to Liaoyang; the chapter elsewhere (s0007) dates the move to Shenyang to Tianming 10. Year converted from the Qing reign period with a standard reign-year table (external conversion; inferred). The packet supplies no Qing reign table, so no reignId is used.

claims.statement: After fixing Shenyang, Taizu ordered banner soldiers to build a raised road 120 li straight to Liaoyang across the marshy western route.

claims.event: Taizong rebuilt Yong'an Bridge; the chapter dates the bridge's building to Chongde 6, which is taken as the date of his rebuilding (inferred). Year converted from the Qing reign period with a standard reign-year table (external conversion; inferred). The packet supplies no Qing reign table, so no reignId is used.

claims.statement: Taizong rebuilt Yong'an Bridge, easing travel.
